name: Gauge Demo Event Analytics
description: A dashboard for understanding how visitors interact with a website.
Readme:
# Event Analytics

This example describes a dashboard for website operators. An operator selects a date range to see which pages visitors opened and which actions they completed.

## Example task

Compare this week's sign-ups with last week's and identify the pages where the most sign-ups started.

name: Gauge Demo Customer Messaging
description: A tool for planning customer messages around actions people take in a product.
Readme:
# Customer Messaging

This example describes a tool for customer success teams. A team defines an audience, chooses a message, and schedules it around a customer action.

## Example task

Send a welcome message after sign-up and schedule a reminder for customers who have yet to finish onboarding.
